Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.
Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.
Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.
Customer experience
Customer experience at Nebius AI Cloud involves tackling customers’ challenges and directly impacting their success by solving real-world AI and ML problems at massive GPU cloud scale. You’ll not only resolve issues, but play a key role in shaping clients’ business success by optimizing their AI solutions.
Working with advanced GPUs such as H200, B200 and GB200, as well as modern ML frameworks, you’ll influence the development of the Nebius AI Cloud and gain experience at the intersection of infrastructure and AI. With minimal bureaucracy, you’ll have the freedom to innovate, take ownership and drive change. Opportunities for growth are abundant in this vibrant and supportive professional community.

Our flagship brands, LiftMaster® and Chamberlain® , are found in 51+ million homes, and 14 million+ people rely on the myQ® app daily. The Chief Software Architect is responsible for defining, evolving, and governing the end-to-end architecture of the myQ IoT platform at Chamberlain Group .

Serving as the senior technical authority and architectural voice for the platform, the Chief Software Architect champions modern cloud-native practices, scalable architectural patterns, and strategic technology adoption, guiding engineering teams through platform modernization and continuous evolution.

In close partnership with Engineering, Product Management, and cross-functional stakeholders, the role translates business and customer requirements into cohesive architectural strategies and standards, ensuring the myQ ecosystem delivers secure, reliable, and seamless connected access experiences, while supporting rapid innovation across Chamberlain’s growing product lines and partner ecosystem.

Shopware ist eine führende Open-Commerce-Plattform, die Händler dabei unterstützt, flexible, skalierbare und zukunftssichere digitale Commerce-Erlebnisse aufzubauen. Wir arbeiten eng mit Händlern, Agenturen und Technologiepartnern zusammen, um anspruchsvolle E-Commerce-Lösungen für ambitionierte Marken zu realisieren.
Über die Rolle
Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Solution Architect (m/w/d) , der skalierbare E-Commerce-Lösungen für Mid-Market- und Enterprise-Kunden konzipiert, begleitet und validiert. Diese Rolle befindet sich an der Schnittstelle zwischen geschäftlichen Anforderungen und technischer Umsetzung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit den Teams aus Sales, Customer Success sowie Implementierungspartnern zusammen, um erfolgreiche, zukunftssichere Lösungen und termingerechte Go-Lives sicherzustellen.
Als Solution Architect (m/w/d) verantwortest du das Lösungsdesign von der Pre-Sales-Phase bis hin zu den ersten Schritten nach dem Launch. Du übersetzt komplexe geschäftliche Anforderungen in klare technische Architekturen und stellst sicher, dass diese mit den Möglichkeiten der Plattform, bewährten Best Practices und den Delivery-Modellen unserer Partner übereinstimmen.
Solution Design & Architektur
Durchführung umfassender technischer Discovery-Workshops, um Geschäftsmodelle, Anforderungen, Rahmenbedingungen und Erfolgskriterien der Kunden zu verstehen.
Konzeption ganzheitlicher E-Commerce-Architekturen, einschließlich der Konfiguration der Kernplattform, Integrationen, individueller Erweiterungen und Drittanbietertechnologien.
Definition von Architekturmustern, Datenflüssen und Integrationsstrategien unter Berücksichtigung von Best Practices hinsichtlich Skalierbarkeit, Performance und Sicherheit.
Bewertung von Vor- und Nachteilen individueller Entwicklungen gegenüber Standardfunktionen der Plattform.
Unterstützung bei der Implementierung
Tätigkeit als primäre technische Ansprechperson während des Implementierungsprozesses und Unterstützung von Partnern bei Entwicklung, Integrationen und Go-Lives.
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Vertrieb bei Vertriebsstrategien, der Definition von Projektumfängen, Aufwandsschätzungen und Risikobewertungen.
Verständliche Vermittlung technischer Konzepte, Annahmen und Rahmenbedingungen an technische sowie geschäftliche Stakeholder auf Management-Ebene.
Unterstützung bei Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs) und technischen Validierungen bei Bedarf.

Überprüfung von Lösungsdesigns und Implementierungsplänen der Partner hinsichtlich der Einhaltung von Plattformstandards und Best Practices.
Unterstützung während des Onboardings sowie in den frühen Projektphasen, um reibungslose Kunden-Launches sicherzustellen.

About Zelara
Most CRM marketing still blasts generic messages at scale and calls it "personalization." Our founders experienced this firsthand in senior roles at HelloFresh, Salesforce, Uber, and others. Backed by top-tier VCs, they decided to build a better way.
Zelara is an agentic lifecycle marketing platform that improves with every interaction. It works with the CRM infrastructure our customers already use, replacing static journeys and manual segmentation with a system that creates content, makes individual-level decisions, and learns from every outcome.
With bunq, Europe's second-largest neobank, we delivered +7.4% activation and +66% reactivation uplift , measured against a control group. We raised a €3M pre-seed and are generating revenue with paying enterprise customers. Now we are hiring our first Solutions Architect to make the path from integration to measurable value repeatable.

This is a deeply technical customer role centered on post-sales value realization, with involvement in pre-sales discovery. It is not conventional customer success built around reactive support and business reviews, nor a pre-sales role that hands off at signature.
You will own technical value realization for a portfolio of customers, from discovery and onboarding through live experiments, measured results, and scaled adoption.
You and the commercial lead run each account as a pair, in a weekly rhythm and in the room together for the conversations that decide something. They own pricing, proposals, contracts, conversion to an annual contract, expansion, and renewal. You own the technical plan and evidence behind those decisions.

Before signature, you lead technical discovery alongside them. After signature, you become the customer's named technical lead, accountable for solution design, data mapping, the experiment plan, stakeholder coordination, and go-live. You make value real and defensible; the commercial lead owns the close.
There is no separate customer success manager, and we are not planning one. The two of you hold the whole relationship: the commercial lead is the account owner, you are the technical owner, and the working relationship with the customer's CRM, data, and analytics teams is yours.
Your focus is the customer-specific application of Zelara's platform. Product owns the roadmap and prioritization. Engineering owns production software, reusable integrations, reliability, and security. Science owns the learning methods and models, experimental methodology, and causal measurement standards. You turn their work into a functioning customer solution and bring in each team when a requirement crosses those boundaries.
Today our founders lead the technical side of every customer relationship. You will take over that responsibility and build the function as the customer base grows.
You will work with mid-market and enterprise B2C companies across Europe: fintech, e-commerce, travel, and employee benefits. Successful pilots grow into long-term, scaled deployments.
